title: The impact of innovation capabilities on SME performance in emerging markets: evidence from Indonesia
core_idea: Investigate how three dimensions of innovation capability—product, process, and market innovation—affect the performance of SMEs in the manufacturing subsectors of East Java, Indonesia, using a quantitative survey and PLS-SEM analysis.
tldr: This study aims to assess the influence of product, process, and market innovation capabilities on SME performance in East Java manufacturing by surveying 160 firms and analyzing the data with PLS-SEM.
